meta.description: Teknoppy is a trusted WordPress development company Kochi delivering custom WordPress websites, WooCommerce development, and migration services for Kerala businesses. AWS certified developers since 2018.

hero.body: Custom · Mobile-First · SEO-Ready WordPress Solutions for Kerala Businesses Since 2018. We build WordPress platforms that rank, convert, and scale.

paragraphs: Teknoppy is a professional WordPress development company Kochi delivering custom, mobile-first, SEO-ready WordPress solutions for businesses across Kerala. Since 2018, we have completed 120+ WordPress projects — from focused WordPress web design to large-scale enterprise WordPress development — helping Kerala brands build a strong digital presence and generate consistent leads online.

Every business needs more than a standard website. It needs a fast, credible, search-optimised platform that turns visitors into paying customers. As a dedicated WordPress development company, Teknoppy combines professional WordPress web design with custom development, on-page SEO architecture, structured schema markup, and Core Web Vitals optimisation — so your WordPress site ranks and converts. Our clients include startups, hospitals, real estate firms, restaurants, manufacturers, and established enterprises across Kochi, Thrissur, Calicut, Trivandrum, and the wider Kerala market.

process.intro: Our professional web design process follows six clearly defined stages, ensuring every project is delivered on time, within budget, and built precisely to brief.

steps.title: WordPress Architecture Planning
steps.desc: Custom WordPress structure, URL hierarchy, database design, and internal-linking strategy preventing keyword cannibalization and ensuring clean crawlability.

steps.title: WordPress Web Design & Wireframing
steps.desc: Low-fidelity wireframes approved before development. High-fidelity mockups for WordPress web design ensuring zero revision surprises after coding starts.

steps.title: Custom WordPress Development

steps.title: SEO Setup & Content Migration
steps.desc: On-page SEO optimization, schema markup implementation, sitemap generation, and Google Search Console verification for WordPress ranking readiness.

steps.title: Testing, Launch & Training
steps.desc: Full cross-browser cross-device testing, WordPress security hardening, performance verification, sitemap submission, and comprehensive handover documentation.

faqs.intro: Get quick answers to standard questions about custom WordPress development pricing, process, and technical SEO features.

items.q: What services does a WordPress development company offer?
items.a: Professional WordPress development companies offer custom WordPress web design, custom development, WooCommerce e-commerce, WordPress maintenance, migration services, speed optimization, and ongoing support covering discovery through launch and beyond.

items.q: How much does WordPress development cost in Kochi?
items.a: Costs range from Rs. 40,000 for basic websites to Rs. 4,00,000+ for enterprise WordPress solutions. Every project receives a written quote based on pages, functionality, and complexity.

items.q: How long does WordPress development take?
items.a: Standard WordPress websites take 3-5 weeks from discovery to launch. Larger sites with custom functionality can take 6-12 weeks. Written timelines are provided at project start.

items.q: Can you migrate my existing website to WordPress?
items.a: Yes. Our WordPress migration services handle transfers from Shopify, Wix, Blogger, and other platforms while preserving SEO rankings and implementing proper redirects.

items.q: Is custom WordPress development better than templates?
items.a: Custom WordPress development provides better security, performance, scalability, and unique branding compared to template-based solutions. Custom WordPress is built specifically for your business requirements.
Yes. WordPress with proper optimization is highly SEO-friendly. Every WordPress site includes on-page SEO, schema markup, mobile optimization, and speed tuning standard.

items.q: What makes a WordPress website secure?
items.a: Security includes SSL certificates, daily backups, malware scanning, security hardening, regular WordPress core updates, plugin updates, and 24/7 monitoring.

items.q: Does your WordPress development company provide ongoing support?
items.a: Yes. Monthly WordPress maintenance plans cover updates, security monitoring, speed optimization, content changes, and technical WordPress support.

items.q: Do you offer multilingual WordPress development?
items.a: Yes. We build multilingual WordPress websites for businesses wanting to reach both Malayalam-speaking and international audiences — especially valuable for tourism, Ayurveda, and export-oriented businesses.

items.q: How do I get started with Teknoppy?
items.a: Contact us via the Contact page, request a quote, or book a free 30-minute consultation. We respond to all enquiries within one business day.

items.q: Do you provide website maintenance after launch?
items.a: Yes. Monthly WordPress maintenance plans from Rs. 5,000 per month cover updates, security monitoring, speed checks, content edits, and technical fixes.
